summary_claims.claim: Companion chatbot platforms must bar minors without parental consent and remind minors hourly that the bot is not human
AI companies may sell personal information only as deidentified data; consent for AI likenesses; schools barred from AI instructional tools before grade 6

note: The bill passed the Senate 37-1 and died in the House on 29 Apr 2026; the search agrees and found no later action. Status Lapsed is supported.
